caption:
One team or many? The apostrophe tells you.

One team → team's. Many teams → teams'. Write the plural first, then add the apostrophe.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: One team or many? team's = one team, teams' = many teams.

youtube.title: Plural Possessives on the SAT: team's vs. teams'
youtube.description: For one owner add 's; for a plural ending in s, add only an apostrophe. Write the plural first, then the apostrophe.
